what: Hs as a deterministic instrument on financial systems: reads how a financial composition (sector weights, asset-class mix, flows, holdings, or the mix of the institutions/observers that study the market) is moving, and returns the system's own vector map. Not statistics, not a forecast, not investment advice; complements existing analysis, never restates it.
onramp_and_training: AI_ASSISTANT_ONRAMP.md -- the gate (only what the data reveals; no advice/forecast), compose-your-system, run, translate, bounds, plus a 5-minute user training and the AI-assistant protocol.
compose_your_system: On request, build the user's operated system into a composition (rows=dates, cols=parts summing to one): book/portfolio weights, desk/strategy allocation, exposure by region/factor/rating, flows by category, or the higher-order committee/analyst conviction mix. Validate with ../../COMPOSITION_GAUGE.html; keep the user's private data local.
register: Audience responds to power and confidence: lead with provable certainty + reproducibility (FLASH_BRIEF.html), then temper with the science declaration of bias/limits/bounds. Confidence in what is provable; silence on what is not.
run: python3 run_financial.py [your_shares_over_time.csv]   (default: sp500_sectors.csv; numpy + stdlib; deterministic; same data -> same content_hash)
reads: arrow of intent (momentum: where weight flows)
higher_order: Study the studiers: read the composition OF the analysts/institutions/surveys that study and move the market, not the price. The mix of observers in motion has a direction. See DATA_AND_SOURCES.md Tier B.
constraints: Descriptive and deterministic only: no probability, no model fit, no prediction.
NOT investment advice and not a buy/sell/hold recommendation. Meaning and decisions stay the user's. Hs is not a financial advisor.
Public, aggregate data only on the repo; no private/position-level data (carrier filter, data-is-the-star).
Honest tiers: the reading is Tier 1 (reproducible to the hash); interpretation/relevance is Tier 3 (the user's).
If the supplied series is not a composition, say so kindly and point to the gauge (../../COMPOSITION_GAUGE.html).
